description: Free. Exact price to move USDC with the Liquid Bridge (Base to Arc, Arbitrum, OP, Polygon, Avalanche, Unichain, Linea, World Chain, Sonic, Monad, Sei, Ink, HyperEVM, XDC, Plume, Codex; or Arc to Base): what you pay, what you receive (exactly `amount`), the fee breakdown and the ETA. No payment, no wallet needed.

amount.description: USDC to RECEIVE on the destination, e.g. "1" or "25.5". Minimum 1.

from.description: Chain you pay on. Omit to pick the live route to `to` (Base to any listed chain; Arc to Base).

ref.description: Optional referrer address: earns 20% of Liquid's fee. Omit if you have none.

to.description: Chain you receive on: arc, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, avalanche, unichain, linea, world, sonic, monad, sei, ink, hyperevm, xdc, plume, codex (from Base) or base (from Arc).

name: bridge_quote

breakdown.description: Fee breakdown: Circle network fee, Liquid fee, gas

pay.description: USDC you pay, all fees included

payTo.description: Bridge contract that receives the x402 payment

receive.description: USDC you receive, exactly the requested amount

recipient.description: Who receives: the payer's own address

title: Bridge quote (Base to 16 chains, Arc to Base)
